name: teams
title: Microsoft Teams
description: One channel's conversations in Microsoft Teams. Connect Microsoft first, then pick the one channel this source reads. Work or school accounts only — the Teams message APIs do not support personal Microsoft accounts.

channel.label: Channel
channel.hint: Pick from the teams you have joined, or type '{team id}/{channel id}'. Both ids are needed: Graph reaches a channel only through its team, and a channel id is not unique across teams. Watching several channels? Add one source per channel.
